data.name: Yahdina
data.gender_notes: Yahdina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Yahdina means 'Jehovah Knows'. This name was given to a woman in the Bible who was barren, and God heard her prayer and granted her a son. The name Yahdina carries the meaning “Jehovah's Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Yahdina usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah's knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder of God's knowledge and love for us.
data.etymology: Yahdina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jehovah's Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yahdina total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: יהדינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהדינה הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו אלוהים ישפוט ויורד על הבריות, מקור השם הוא מהשפה העברית ומורכב מהמילים 'יהו' ו'דינה' שפירושם אלוהים ומשפט דין בהתאמה, השם מוזכר בשורשים עבריים עתיקים ומשמש כזכרון לתפילות ולברכות בישראל

in_greek.name: Υαχδίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Υαχδίνη είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει Θεός κρίνει και καταδεικνύει, η ονοματοδοσία βασίζεται στη σύνθεση των λέξεων 'Yah' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'dina' που σημαίνει κρίση, το όνομα αυτό αποτέλεσε σημαντικό στοιχείο στη ζωή των πρώτων χριστιανών και στη λειτουργική τους γλώσσα

in_latin.name: Yahdina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Yahdina origine hebraicum est et significat Deus judicat et demonstrat, constructum ex vocibus 'Yah' quae Deum significat et 'dina' quae judicium indicat, nomen hoc usitatum est in traditione christiana et reperitur in documentis ecclesiasticis veteribus

in_english.name: Yahdina
in_english.meaning: God judges and descends upon the people
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yahdina originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the words 'Yah' meaning God and 'dina' meaning judgment or God will judge, it carries a profound spiritual significance reflecting divine justice and providence, used in Christian traditions to signify a child born under God's judgment and mercy

data.cultural_impact: The name Yahdina holds cultural significance in Jewish tradition and the Hebrew language. In many Jewish communities, names are much more than just identifiers; they're believed to possess spiritual power and influence the bearer's life. In this case, Yahdina honors the belief that God is always aware of and involved in our lives. Yahdina's story in the Bible is a powerful reminder of the importance of faith and the belief that even when we face seemingly insurmountable struggles, God hears our prayers and can bring us through.
data.spiritual_significance: Yahdina's name reflects a deep spiritual truth - that we are never truly alone, and that God knows us intimately. It's a reminder of the promise in Psalm 147:5 that "Great is our Lord and abundant in power; his understanding is beyond measure." This name encourages a sense of trust and reliance on God, and a reminder that even in our darkest moments, He sees us and knows us. It's a beautiful way to honor God's love and faithfulness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yahdina, meaning "Guided by Yahweh" in Hebrew, symbolizes the unwavering faith and trust in God's guidance and protection throughout one's journey in life. It is a reminder that even in the darkest of times, Yahweh, the ever-present God, illuminates the path and leads the way towards a fulfilling and purposeful life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Yahdina is mentioned in the 10th century Arabic text 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a female singer. The name Yahdina carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Yahdina continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Yahdina from London, United Kingdom embodies the meaning of Yahdina - "Jehovah's Knowledge". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
